literal: Disease having investigated, disease's root cause having investigated, that which mitigates way having investigated, so as to succeed, act.
translation: Diagnose the disease, diagnose its root cause, investigate the proper method to cure it, and then administer the treatment effectively.
modern: நோயை ஆராய்ந்து, நோயின் மூல காரணத்தை ஆராய்ந்து, அதைத் தணிக்கும் வழியை ஆராய்ந்து, அது பலிக்கும்படி செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the systematic approach required for medical treatment. First, the physician must identify the specific disease. Second, they must investigate its root cause rather than just treating the symptoms. Third, they must find the correct method or remedy to cure it. Finally, they must execute the treatment in a way that ensures success. The repetition of the word 'நாடி' (having investigated) emphasizes that careful diagnosis and inquiry must precede any action.
